create_image_processor: create a DeepseekVLHybridImageProcessorPil instance with custom high resolution size and resampling settings
preprocess_images: preprocess a batch of images into pixel values and high resolution pixel values for the model
resize_image_to_square: resize a numpy image array to a square size with a minimum size floor
pad_image_to_square: pad a non-square numpy image to a square using a specified background color
standardize_processor_kwargs: standardize size, high_res_size, and mean/std kwargs into SizeDict and tuple formats
